bio_text: Luke Bechtel is a full-stack founding engineer and creative technologist based in San Francisco, with a background spanning industrial automation, neural network research, and 3D printing. He founded Reasonote (On Deck Founders cohort ODF22), an AI-powered adaptive learning platform, and now serves as Founding Engineer at Infinity AI Institute, a YC-backed generative video company building a script-to-movie foundation model. He is drawn to positive-sum games, improv, music, and storytelling, and channels that curiosity into building educational and creative AI tools.
